real_defects.issue: IRA detection was a bare substring test (/ira|roth|401|403|sep|retire|hsa/), so an account number like 'Individual Z40123456' or a name like 'September Growth' was read as a retirement account and its loss sales silently skipped (summary showed 0 sales). Now whole-token match.

reportCsv wrote the symbol unquoted: a quoted broker symbol such as "BRK,B" shifted every later column of the report one place right, and a symbol starting '=' was written as a live formula (file was on the CSV formula-guard baseline). Cells are now quoted and formula-prefixed; removed from the baseline.

parseDate accepted a 3-digit US-date year ('1/2/202' -> year 202 AD), so a typo'd row was placed 1800 years early and never matched any wash window instead of being refused. Now 2- or 4-digit years only.
